label: Kasseri
note: Kashkaval (Balkans) and kaşar (Turkey) are the same kind of cheese

about.text: Kasseri is a Greek pasta filata cheese made from sheep's milk, with at most 20 % goat's milk. It is made in Thessaly, Macedonia, Lesbos and Xanthi, and holds a Greek PDO. Turkish kaşar and Balkan kashkaval are the same family.
